notes: Account background: Series B infra company (observability + dev tools). Heavy internal engineering org (200+ eng). Existing search is Elastic + custom heuristics; moving to vector-first RAG for code and docs.
Primary ask: scale embeddings + reranking for codebase search (internal monorepo + customer repos). Need low-latency recall for developer workflows and PR triage.
Scale targets: initial index 10M vectors for POC, target production 120M+ vectors (code snippets + metadata). Frequent updates: incremental diffs nightly, full re-index weekly.
Performance targets quoted by CTO (Alex Reddy): 'sub-100ms for top-10 recall at 95th percentile; overall developer interactive feel <200ms end-to-end.'
Traffic profile: average 20 QPS, peak 80 QPS during morning syncs and release windows. Typical query: embed -> ANN retrieval -> bi-encoder rerank -> optional cross-encoder on top-k candidates.
Latency & cost constraints: want vector search p50 <40ms, p95 <120ms; cross-encoder rerank limited to <=5 candidates to cap cost. Cost per query target (embeddings + rerank) < $0.0015-$0.002.

Model preferences: open/quantized encoders for embeddings (1536 dim), cross-encoder for rerank (smaller sequence lengths, higher compute). Interested in Redwood's model catalog + quantization profiles.
Indexing concerns: need incremental reindex API, snapshotting for rollback, ability to do zero-downtime rollouts of index variants. Strong interest in prefix/KV caching for hot paths.

Security/compliance: must support Okta SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, enterprise audit logs retained 1 year, customer-managed KMS (AWS) and key rotation policy. EU data residency for EU engineering orgs.
Procurement note: legal team flagged indemnity and data processing addendum. Finance needs ARR band justification; procurement timeframe ~May 2026.

Competitive landscape: evaluating Elastic Cloud + native ANN add-ons, Pinecone for vector infra, also trialling self-hosted Weaviate. Redwood differentiator to validate: dedicated capacity + predictable unit economics.
Quote from head of Platform Eng (Priya Desai): 'We will reindex nightly for customer-visible docs; downtime is unacceptable. Need incremental diff + fast bulk load story.'
Operational asks: per-route tracing, token-level cost breakdown, model-level rollbacks, canary for index variants, SLA around dedicated pools during release windows.
POC scope discussed: 2-week POC. Phase 1: load 10M vectors, 50 QPS sustained 1 hour, measure p50/p95. Phase 2: scale to 100M, test nightly incremental, validate SSO and KMS integration.
Accepted test metrics for POC: vector recall@10 >= 0.88 on internal dev set, vector search p95 <120ms, rerank p50 <120ms, cost per effective query <= $0.0018.
Integration notes: will provide IdP metadata (Okta) and a staging VPC. Security wants a short security questionnaire answered before infra access — we have 'Redwood security FAQ' link in drive.
Next logistics: SE to schedule infra sizing call + collect sample corpus (sanitized) by 2026-03-08. Legal to receive draft SOW by 2026-03-15.
Potential upsell: Dedicated reserved capacity for sustained load + Private for EU-only workloads; Optimize for automated batching/quant recommendations.
Internal contact map: CTO Alex Reddy (decision maker), Platform Eng lead Priya Desai (technical lead), SecOps Miles Chen (security reviewer).
Open questions from POC kickoff: 1) can Redwood support multi-region index replication? 2) how are KV/prefix caches warmed on large cold start? 3) staging KMS integration steps?
Suggested wins: show cost/per-query breakdown vs Pinecone + self-hosted GPU baseline; demonstrate incremental reindex under 30 minutes for 10M delta set.
